task: End-to-end test suite for conveyor-to-shipping gateway integration. Validate the full flow from sorter assignment to courier dispatch, guaranteeing zero regressions in tracking number assignment.
checklist: Automated script simulates PLC package drops into courier chutes
Shipping Provider APIs receive correct weight/dimensions
Tracking labels are correctly generated and mapped to the order
Negative: package drop with missing weight -> flagged, not shipped with default/zero weight
Edge: courier API is temporarily unavailable -> package is held/retried, not lost or misrouted
Edge: same order processed twice by the sorter (double drop) -> only one tracking number is issued
Cross-check: chute-to-courier mapping matches the configured routing table
Regression: previous known ASB-1247 cancellation reset scenario still passes end-to-end
